title: metadata-protocol: a pair address (?package=<base>.custom) takes its envelope from the first registered holder of the name, so it answers one package's body under another's _packageId
body:
epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYGYEUhpi29FpjLmxT

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named location, reproduced. Found by the #32183 dev (PR #32497) while preparing ruling (c)'s qualifier hunk; the notes are in the project files at `epic-31527/card-32183/hunk-prep-notes.md`. Part of #31527 (ADR-0150).

## 维护者速读

- 改什么：按配对地址读取元数据（`?package=<基包>.custom`）时，返回体的 `_packageId` 取自最先注册的那个持有者，而不是地址指向的那个包。
- 为什么：两个包持有同名项时，后注册那个包的配对地址会返回它自己的内容，却标成先注册那个包的。若先注册的那个包被停用，启用包的配对地址还会答 404。
- 风险：第一方 0 处（要求两个命名空间持有同名项）；属于错误的归属，不丢数据。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` 的 `envelopePackageId(request.packageId, item)` → `lookupArtifactItem` → any-composite 回落。
- 验证：alpha、beta 都持有 `d1`，beta 先注册，读 `?package=com.acme.alpha.custom`，应返回 alpha 的内容和 `_packageId: com.acme.alpha`。
- 需要你做的：无，归专题席派发。

## The defect

Two enabled packages hold a name, and the other registered first. The pair address of the second serves the second's body under the first's envelope. Example: `?package=com.acme.alpha.custom` answers `alpha dashboard` with `_packageId: com.acme.beta`, on both transports.

The envelope is looked up at the pair id (`envelopePackageId`), and `getArtifactItem`'s any-composite tier falls back to the first holder that ships the name. With a disabled holder registered first, the same misstamp makes the enabled base's pair address answer 404.

Measured on #32214's head `17cfbf8b3`. The lookup is on `main` and outside #32214's diff, so `main` very likely has it too; measure `main` first. PR #32497 does not move it; its CONTROL pin is limited to the enabled-first order, and says why.

Expected: the envelope of an exact address names the package that address reads, never one picked by registration order (epic red line 2).

reach: `GET /meta/:type/:name?package=<base>.custom` when two namespaces hold the name. First-party: 0.

## Reader

The epic seat `epic:#31527#1` dispatches it after PR #32497 (#32183) lands, since both touch the exact-address face.

Blocked-by: #32183

Dedupe (open and closed): `pair address envelope`, `envelopePackageId`, `getArtifactItem any-composite`, `.custom _packageId` → none.
Grade: p2.
